name: RMM pricing transparency dataset for one-technician MSPs
description: Fourteen source-dated RMM pricing records covering published numeric prices, free tiers, source-available software, published ranges, and quote-only vendors. Exact monthly costs are provided for one technician at 10, 50, 100, and 500 endpoints only when official public rates support the arithmetic.

distribution.name: public-rmm-pricing-comparison-2026-11-02.csv
distribution.description: UTF-8 CSV with one source-dated pricing disclosure per product.

recordSet.name: RMM pricing disclosures
recordSet.description: One record per RMM product or edition, with public-price visibility, normalized scenario costs, source, and fact-check date.

field.name: billing_term_for_estimate
field.description: Billing term used for normalized monthly values.

field.name: public_price_visibility
field.description: Visibility class: numeric_public, free_tier_only, source_available, range_and_quote, or quote_only.

field.name: one_technician_endpoints_10_usd_month
field.description: Exact public monthly subscription cost in USD for one technician and 10 endpoints; blank when not publicly computable.

field.name: one_technician_endpoints_50_usd_month
field.description: Exact public monthly subscription cost in USD for one technician and 50 endpoints; blank when not publicly computable.

field.name: one_technician_endpoints_100_usd_month
field.description: Exact public monthly subscription cost in USD for one technician and 100 endpoints; blank when not publicly computable.

field.name: one_technician_endpoints_500_usd_month
field.description: Exact public monthly subscription cost in USD for one technician and 500 endpoints; blank when not publicly computable.

field.name: month_to_month_alternative_usd
field.description: Published month-to-month alternative in USD when the normalized estimate uses annual billing.

field.name: source_url
field.description: Official vendor source used to verify the record.

field.name: fact_checked
field.description: Date the linked official source was manually checked.

field.name: notes
field.description: Scope, interpretation, and limitation notes for the record.
